summary_ja: 金融機関・第一種金融商品取引業者・保険会社・法人等向けエクスポージャーに短期格付がある場合のリスク・ウェイトを定め、同一債務者の他の短期無格付・無格付エクスポージャーへの波及と、金融機関向け短期エクスポージャーの取扱いを定める。
summary_en: Short-term ratings set the risk weight of bank, securities-firm, insurer and corporate exposures, with knock-on floors for the same obligor's other unrated short-term and unrated exposures, and rules for other short-term bank exposures.
paragraphs: Where a short-term rating has been assigned to exposures to financial institutions, exposures to Type I financial instruments business operators, exposures to insurance companies or exposures to corporates, etc. (including exposures to specialized lending), notwithstanding the provisions of Article 30 through the preceding Article, the risk weight of those exposures shall be as set out in the left column of the following table, according to the credit risk category corresponding to that short-term rating. {{T:p77t0}}

Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach has a short-term, unrated exposure to the obligor of an exposure to which a risk weight of 50% or 100% applies under the preceding paragraph, the risk weight of that short-term, unrated exposure shall not be less than 100%.

An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach shall also apply a 150% risk weight to other unrated exposures to the obligor of an exposure to which a 150% risk weight applies under paragraph (1).

Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach has, to the obligor of an exposure to financial institutions to which paragraph (1) applies (including exposures to Type I financial instruments business operators and exposures to insurance companies under the provisions of Article 30; the same applies hereinafter in this paragraph), a short-term exposure other than that exposure to financial institutions (meaning one to which no short-term rating has been assigned and which falls under paragraph (2), item (ii) of that Article), the risk weight of that short-term exposure, notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph (1) or paragraphs (2) and (4) of that Article, shall be as specified in each of the following items according to the case listed in that item; provided, however, that this shall not apply where the risk weight determined to be 30%, 50% or 100% under the provisions of paragraph (1) and paragraph (4) of that Article is applied to that short-term exposure. (i) Where the risk weight of the exposure to financial institutions exceeds the risk weight of the short-term exposure under Article 30, paragraph (1), or paragraphs (2) and (4): the risk weight of the exposure to financial institutions. (ii) In cases other than that listed in the preceding item: the risk weight determined under Article 30, paragraph (1), or paragraphs (2) and (4).
